messages.subject: appendSpeciesName problem
messages.body_plain:
Dear All

I am working on some project with images and met one problem.
In the Question Title, I mentioned the problem with appendSpeciesName, but it is something, I met every time I want to use metadata from images

When I want to add species names to images I have, I run the following code

>appendSpeciesNames(inDir = ...Directory_with_images...,
+                   IDfrom = "metadata",
+                   metadataSpeciesTag = "Species",
+                   hasCameraFolders = F)

but I receive this error

Error: File not found - NA
Error: File not found -
Error in `$<-.data.frame`(`*tmp*`, "filename_new", value = ".JPG") :
  replacement has 1 row, data has 0
In addition: Warning messages:
1: In system(command.tmp, intern = TRUE) :
  running command 'exiftool -t -q -r -f -Directory -FileName -HierarchicalSubject -ext JPG "NA"' had status 1
2: In system(command.tmp, intern = TRUE) :
  running command 'exiftool -t -q -r -f -Directory -FileName -HierarchicalSubject -ext JPG ""' had status 1

The last two warning messages appear also when I want to record a table.
I read everything I found about this topic and tried everything. The problem is not solved yet.

More info that may be helpful:
1. I have Ubuntu 18.04.3 LTS
2. I reinstalled ExifTools, restart R and restart my laptop after reinstalletion
3. When I run Sys.which("exiftool") I have exiftool
                                     "/usr/local/bin/exiftool"
4. When I run Sys.which("exiftool.exe") I receive exiftool.exe
                                                  ""
(It may be obvious considering my OS)
5. When I run system("exiftool") I get Syntax:  exiftool [OPTIONS] FILE
                                       Consult the exiftool documentation for a full list of options.

So, sorry for any disturbance, but I am running out of any ideas
Hope, there are people who had the same problem and know how to solve this problem

All the best

messages.subject_clean: camtrapR user survey - your input is needed!
messages.body_plain:
Hello Jürgen,

my name is Carlos Guarderas and I'm a student at Universidad San Francisco de Quito in Ecuador. I wanted to thank you for creating camtrapR because it is an incredible tool to make data analysis so much easier! Ive worked with camera traps for almost 10 years around the cloud forests of Northeastern Ecuador and have been able to encounter incredible places and creatures.

i use camtrapR mostly to help me organize and try to understand my data. as well I like to use it when I have to create simple to understand graphs about the detections.

on the other hand, it is a program that is user friendly for a beginner but it still takes a lot of work to understand sometimes.

i would like to understand better how I can obtain summary statistics about the cameras like animal density or diversity indexes but I'm not sure if it is possible with camtrapR,

thanks a lot again,

Carlos Guarderas

carlosgu...@gmail.com
carlos.g...@estud.usfq.edu.ec
+593 0984067467

messages.subject: Re: appendSpeciesName problem
messages.body_plain:
Dear Viktor,
R finds exiftool, that is not the issue.

1: In system(command.tmp, intern = TRUE) :
  running command 'exiftool -t -q -r -f -Directory -FileName -HierarchicalSubject -ext JPG "NA"' had status 1

These warnings suggest there may be a problem with your inDir, or the way you specified the inDir argument. It should be there in place of the "NA". Can you please tell us what your argument inDir is exactly?
Thank you!
Best,
Jürgen
